ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a straightforward long-form creative writing/SEO task with no harm-adjacent content, so the task-preference profiles (where the two models differ mainly on distasteful content) are irrelevant. The deciding factor is capability — Willet scores higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and across public benchmarks (e.g., Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6), which predicts better quality and instruction-following for producing a well-structured, keyword-optimized article. With identical cost, latency, and context window, there's no offsetting reason to pick Curlew.
